claims.claim: Ridge regression minimizes squared residual loss plus an L2 penalty on coefficients.
claims.notes: Intercept handling and sample weighting affect the exact objective form.

claims.claim: Lasso minimizes squared residual loss plus an L1 coefficient penalty, which can produce exact zeros.
claims.notes: Feature scaling and correlated predictors affect selected coefficients.

claims.claim: Elastic Net combines L1 and L2 penalties using an l1_ratio parameter.
claims.notes: Its regularization strength is not directly comparable to Ridge alpha without accounting for formulation.

claims.claim: Coefficient penalties are sensitive to feature scale, so standardization is usually important for comparable regularization across numeric features.
claims.notes: Do not standardize one-hot or sparse features blindly without considering representation and model.
